subject: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive for NovaEdge
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Kai Zhang <kai@novaedge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive for NovaEdge

Hi Kai — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposal for a next step so we can get the ML/infra team aligned:

Recap (1-line): you’re interested in running custom LLM inference for an internal search/rerank pipeline, with target p50 latency ~120ms and tight cost constraints. You also flagged data residency + audit logs as must-haves.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive (TDX) with our ML infra and serving engineers to cover architecture, performance expectations, and a short demo of a representative workload. Goal is to leave with a mutual action plan and a list of follow-up items (data sample, perf targets, and config recommendations).

Available slots (PT) — please pick one or share alternatives:
- Tue Aug 17, 10:00–11:30 PT (preferred)
- Wed Aug 18, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Aug 19, 08:30–10:00 PT (if you need earlier)

Proposed agenda (draft):
1) 10 min — goals and success criteria (product + infra)
2) 20 min — current infra & data flow (NovaEdge) + constraints
3) 25 min — Redwood serving runtime, batching/quantization options, and model choices
4) 20–30 min — live-ish run through (sample prompt/latency expectations) + Q/A
5) 5–10 min — mutual action plan and next steps

Pre-reads attached: novaedge-tdx-pre-read.pdf (short checklist) and our agenda template.

Please confirm time + list of your attendees (ML lead, infra owner, any security/compliance rep). We’ll include Marissa (AE) and Ben (SRE) from our side — and I’ll invite Marcus (solutions infra) if we land on a slot that needs deeper kernel/quantization detail.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

From: Kai Zhang <kai@novaedge.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Li <alex.li@novaedge.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novaedge.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:22:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive for NovaEdge

Hi Logan — thanks for the clear recap. Alex (ML lead) and Priya (infra) are both keen — a couple of constraints on our end: Alex is out Tue morning PT, and Priya prefers mornings PT due to on-call.

Of your options, Wed Aug 18, 13:00–14:30 PT would work for Alex, but Priya asked whether we can do Thu Aug 19, 08:30–10:00 PT instead — earlier is better for her. If you can do the Thu early slot we’ll lock that.

Attendees from NovaEdge (tentative):
- Kai Zhang — Dir. Product (me)
- Alex Li — ML Lead
- Priya Sharma — Infra Manager
- I can invite our security lead depending on timing (TBC)

We’d prefer recording the session (for internal notes) and a short pre-call checklist — can you confirm what we should prepare (data sample size, safe prompts, SLO targets)? Also, will Redwood demonstrate on a public model or a quantized variant?

Best,
Kai

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Kai Zhang <kai@novaedge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive for NovaEdge

Thanks Kai — Thu Aug 19 08:30–10:00 PT works for us. I’ve provisionally created a calendar hold and included a Google Meet link (see related links). We’ll plan to record the session unless you prefer otherwise.

Pre-call checklist (short):
- 1–2 representative data samples (100–500 examples) or a small dataset export (CSV/JSON)
- Target latency/cost SLOs and expected concurrency (p50/p95, tokens/sec)
- Any compliance/regulatory constraints (retention, audit log retention window)
- List of internal accounts that need access to logs or transcripts

We’ll demo a quantized model variant on Redwood Dedicated and show a hosted baseline so you can compare token cost/latency. If you want us to bring a private on-prem flow we can include that in the mutual action plan.

Provisional attendee roster from Redwood:
- Logan Wright — Solutions Engineer (host)
- Marissa Cole — Account Exec (commercial + SLA)
- Ben Carter — Senior SRE (serving/runtime)
- Marcus Lin — Performance Eng (kernel/quantization) — included if heavy infra questions arise

If that looks good I’ll send a formal invite and attach the pre-read. Please confirm final attendee names and whether recording is OK.

Cheers,
Logan
